topic: Phone torch through finger shows veins
hook: Your finger over the phone torch glows red and shows your veins.
title: Your Phone Torch Can Show Your Veins
description:
Cover your phone's torch with a fingertip in a dim room and your finger glows red. Light passes through your flesh, and the darker lines you see are blood vessels. It works on any phone with a torch.

#Shorts #PhoneTricks #TryThis
comment_prompt: Did it work? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your finger over the phone torch glows red.
scenes.headline: Finger Glows Red

scenes.narration: Turn the torch on in a dim room.
scenes.headline: Torch On, Lights Dim

scenes.narration: Press your fingertip gently over the light.
scenes.headline: Cover It With A Finger

scenes.narration: Your whole finger lights up from inside.
scenes.headline: Lit From Inside

scenes.narration: The light is passing through your flesh.
scenes.headline: Light Through Flesh

scenes.narration: Those dark lines are your blood vessels.
scenes.headline: Those Are Your Veins

scenes.narration: Red light travels through skin better than other colours.
scenes.headline: Red Gets Through

scenes.narration: Your finger is glowing red, so go try it.
scenes.headline: Go Try It
